name: La Nava (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of light blue, white and green with a broad white stripe, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of La Nava (a tree on green above waves).
history: Municipal flag of La Nava; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: La Nava arms — tree on green above waves
sun and crown of the arms
